sanskrit: etāni kramaśo da(va)kṣye sarvaṃ śrutibhiratra ca ||
vro mahattaro bhaktiḥ śivaika viṣayā sadā ||
śaktyā prapañca sṛṣṭiḥ syādbhaktyā tadvilayo mataḥ ||
nityaṃ pūrṇa cidānandaṃ sadrūpaṃ brahma kevalam ||
na yathā vidito paśyādyathā devaḥ prasīdati ||
prasannapati(-nnesa-) mūḍho vā paṇḍito vā vimucyate ||
sūryo mukhya śarīraṃ ca bhīmasya paramātmanaḥ ||
yā sandhyā sā jagatsūte māyātītā hi niṣkalā ||
nīlakaṇṭhasya devasya priyo bhaktaḥ sa īritaḥ ||
catvare gṛhamadhye ca na kuryādubhayaṃ naraḥ ||
jale śuddhe samāgatva(tya) jale śaucaṃ samācaret ||
tathā sarvatra saṃyojya paścātpādau ca muttikāṃ ||
ubhayoḥ saptasaṃyojya tisraḥ pādau tataḥ sphicau ||
triguṇaṃ ca vanasthānāṃ yatīnāṃ ca caturguṇam ||
bhojane snānakāle ca maunaṃ ṣaṭcha(su) vidhīyate || iti ||
prakṣālya pādau pāṇī ca dakṣiṇādi krameṇa tu ||
